rockArt.reason: The General tileset's brown rock where no class stands it: the cliffs painted on level ground (Route 120's, the Safari Zone's, the Battle Frontier's), the rock round Lilycove and the shore rock (Rustboro, Routes 119 and 125-126) - every one of these metatiles a blocked cell drew flat in the world sweep of 2026-10-30 (967 cells); not its cave mouths (0x06E, 0x06F, 0x09F) or white ledges. Blocked, it stands as a rock band; walked, it stays ground. Local metatile ids.
